summary: This worksheet blends a cadence view (by contract end date) with capacity / staffing guidance for CS. Weighted ARR uses renewal probability to estimate near-term revenue. Rows prioritized by contract end within the quarter and by weighted ARR. Intend to use this during weekly renewal stand-ups and the Oct-Nov outreach sprints.
calc_notes: Weighted ARR = ARR * (Renewal Probability / 100). Use Weighted ARR sum to forecast expected Q4 renewal inflow. Flag >$100k accounts with probability <60% as escalation candidates. For capacity planning, map expected renewals to CS hours (approx 6 hours per $100k ARR active pursuit).
